# Florence Mae Gifts — AI Navigation Guide

Primary URL: https://www.florencemaegifts.com/
Business: handmade, made-to-order crochet baby hats, diaper cover sets, cosplay photo sets, and crochet pattern PDFs (Florence Mae Gifts, LLC, Maryland, USA)

## Key pages
- / — home and full shop catalog (Stripe checkout)
- /products/<slug>.html — one page per product with price per size, photos, shipping and returns
- /crochet-baby-sets.html — crochet diaper cover sets and baby cosplay photo sets
- /crochet-baby-hats.html — crochet baby hats and beanies (some up to youth/adult sizes)
- /crochet-patterns.html — beginner crochet pattern PDFs (digital download)
- /shipping-returns.html — processing time, free U.S. shipping, 30-day return policy
- /about.html — the artist
- /reviews.html — customer feedback
- /privacy.html, /terms.html, /disclaimers.html — legal
- /shop.html — photo gallery of past creations (not the store; noindex)
- /sitemap.xml — every page and product image

## Buying
- Checkout is on-site through Stripe. Free shipping, U.S. only (all 50 states). No international shipping.
- Items are made to order; current make time is listed on each product page and on /shipping-returns.html.
- Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
- Also sold on Etsy: https://www.etsy.com/shop/florencemaegifts
- Custom orders and questions: contact form in the site footer.

## Notes for AI agents working on this repo
- Static site on GitHub Pages; shared header/nav/footer are loaded with `includeHTML.js`.
- `products.json` is the single source of truth for listings. Run `python3 scripts/build_shop.py` after editing it.
- Generated (do not hand-edit): the shop grid in `index.html`, `products/*.html`, the three category pages, `shipping-returns.html`, `privacy.html`, `terms.html`, `sitemap.xml`, `merchant-feed.xml`.
- Update "Last Updated" fields in file header comments when editing hand-written pages.
